Name: Enhanced Loot Magnet
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod Overview:[/size][/b]

This mod tweaks loot attraction in the following optional, customizable ways:

[list]
[*]It can multiply the range at which loot is attracted to the player (config: set [b]MagnetRangeMult[/b] to a positive [b]decimal[/b])
[*]It can optionally remove range restrictions on loot attraction entirely (config: set [b]MagnetRangeMult[/b] to [b]-1[/b]; this is default)
[*]It can multiply the speed at which loot moves towards the player (config: set [b]MagnetSpeedMult[/b] to an [b]integer[/b] greater than 1; default is 2)
[*]It can optionally instantly teleport loot to the player (config: set [b]MagnetSpeedMult[/b] to [b]-1[/b])
[*]It can remove the initial loot bounce when spawned (config: set [b]NoLootBounce[/b] to [b]true[/b]; default is false)
[*]It can remove the waving motion as loot travels towards the player (config: set [b]NoLootWave[/b] to [b]true[/b]; default is false)
[/list]
By default, it sucks up loot from the entire current location at twice normal speed, and all other options are turned off.

For absolutely instant loot pickup, set [b]MagnetSpeedMult[/b] to [b]-1[/b] and [b]NoLootBounce[/b] to [b]true[/b]


[size=4][b]How To Use:[/b][/size]

To install this mod, just unpack the archive and place the MagnetMod directory in the Mods directory.

To change or enable/disable any of the above options, edit config.json in the Mod directory.

This mod requires the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]Stardew Modding API (SMAPI)[/url] to work.
